result.title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Immediate and Prospective Credit Assignment for Medical Visual Reasoning
result.summary: Medical visual question answering (VQA) requires acquiring useful evidence and deciding where to look next. Yet final-answer rewards do not reveal which observations support answering or guide subsequent inspection. We introduce MedPACT, an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns selective observation policies through immediate answer support and prospective guidance. Our content-controlled estimator compares next actions induced by real and matched alternative observations under a shared real-observation history, isolating how observed content improves subsequent decisions. We combine both forms of credit within GRPO, assigning observation credit to the corresponding tool-call tokens alongside trajectory-level outcome supervision. MedPACT uses a single vision-language model and image-question-answer supervision, with credit estimation confined to training. Experiments with 4B and 8B backbones on six medical VQA benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy, strong out-of-distribution generalization, and substantially lower inference costs. Case studies further illustrate how MedPACT avoids repeated observations and uses acquired evidence to guide subsequent inspection, demonstrating real-world practice potential.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MedPACT，一种面向医学视觉问答的 agentic RL 框架：通过内容控制估计器比较真实与匹配替代观察下诱导的后续动作，将「即时答案支持」与「前瞻性引导」两类信用分配给观察类工具调用 token，并与 GRPO 的轨迹级结果监督结合，训练单一 VLM 的选择性观察策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及视觉证据获取、下一步看哪里以及 LOOK/STOP 式决策，并把信用分配给观察动作，可供核查其内容控制估计是否真能区分因果贡献与表面相关，以及训练期信用估计对推理成本与分布外泛化的影响。
